search_label: Too many bookmarks? Try searching for what you need :)
footer_placeholder: Enter footer text with limited HTML
footer_help: Leave empty to hide the footer. Limited HTML such as a, br, strong, em, span, small, and code is allowed. Scripts, styles, event attributes, and unsafe links are removed automatically.
keep_letter_case: Keep link case consistent with config
icon_mode_default: Hide icons for items without explicit icons
greetings_help: Use a single text like "Hello". Use 4 items split by semicolons for time-based greetings: "Good morning;Good noon;Good afternoon;Good evening". Use 2, 3, or more than 4 items to show one random greeting on each refresh.
module_title_placeholder: Leave empty to use the default title
module_title_help: Leave empty to use the localized default title.
use_theme_color_help: Leave empty to keep the theme color. Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or hex colors.
search_mode_help: Choose whether the home search box filters local bookmarks or jumps to an external search engine.
search_engine_help: Used when search mode is set to search engine.
search_engine_open_mode_help: Choose whether search engine results open in the current tab or a new tab.
search_engine_custom_template_help: The template must contain %s, which is replaced with the encoded query.
search_engine_label: Enter a keyword to open %s search
search_engine_label_new_tab: Enter a keyword to open %s search in a new tab
about_desc_1: SuperFlare is a lightweight self-hosted start page for individuals, focused on high performance and very low resource usage. It helps organize scattered bookmarks, quickly reach LAN services, and manage shortcuts.
about_desc_2: It is deeply enhanced from the open-source GitHub project soulteary/docker-flare and includes login protection, online editing, backup and restore, automatic port discovery, personalized theme customization, automatic icon completion, and multilingual UI support.
about_desc_3: SuperFlare can be deployed conveniently on VPS, LAN, and other environments.
site_icon_help: Choose an MDI icon name. Leave empty to use the default favicon. Full icon library:
custom_background_image_help: Use a remote image URL, local static path, or upload an image below. Leave empty to use the theme background.
upload_background_image_help: Uploaded images are stored locally and replace the background image path above.
home_max_columns_help: 0 uses the default. The layout automatically reduces columns when the viewport is narrower.
home_max_width_help: Unit: px. 0 uses the default width.
custom_theme_help: Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or hex colors. Saving selects the custom theme.
login_pass_config_placeholder: Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password
login_pass_confirm_placeholder: Enter the same password again when changing it
login_pass_confirm_error: The two login passwords do not match.
login_config_runtime_fallback: Persistent login config could not be read. This page is showing the runtime credentials instead. Check config.yml and .env content and permissions.
login_config_runtime_source: config.yml login fields are empty. This page is showing the active runtime credentials; saving will persist them to config.yml and .env.
default_login_credentials_warning: The factory default login credentials are still active. Change the username and password before exposing this service.
login_config_help: The login username cannot be empty. Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password. Saving syncs both config.yml and .env.
ports_help: Ports are collected only when this page is opened or refreshed. Only remarks and hidden state are editable and saved to ports.yaml. Docker scans the container network by default; mount the host /proc and set FLARE_PORT_PROC_ROOT to scan host ports.
ports_load_failed: Failed to load ports. The table is still editable with loaded data.
ports_all_hidden: All ports in the current table are marked hidden.
ports_all_unhidden: All ports in the current table are unhidden.
